follow-up time: From 30-37 weeks of pregnancy to 12-16 weeks postpartum
cohort: 301 pregnant women in their third trimester in Gorgan, Iran
finding: The study found no significant difference in genital self-image from pregnancy to postpartum, regardless of mode of delivery, but found that sexual function scores were significantly higher postpartum in both vaginal and cesarean delivery groups.
mod_finding: Women who had a vaginal birth or cesarean section both experienced significant improvements in sexual function postpartum.
